subject.title: [Feature]: [Feature Request] 按用户维度统计 Token 使用量

question: Should OpenClaw add first-class per-user token accounting to core usage surfaces, and what identity, authorization, and retention model should it use?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but adding user-level billing/quota data changes core product scope and security/privacy boundaries rather than fixing broken existing behavior.

options.title: Sponsor a core design first
options.body: Define the user identity source, authorization checks, storage schema, aggregation API, Dashboard and `/usage` behavior, and privacy/retention rules before implementation.

options.title: Keep user billing external for now
options.body: Use current session/agent/channel/model usage surfaces plus Prometheus or plugins, and avoid storing user-level billing data in core until a stronger multi-user model exists.

options.title: Narrow to existing aggregates
options.body: Close or split this request into smaller agent/session usage improvements and leave per-user quotas out of scope.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a core design first
recommendation.body: Define the user identity source, authorization checks, storage schema, aggregation API, Dashboard and `/usage` behavior, and privacy/retention rules before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent usage Dashboard and gateway cost-analysis history makes this the best available owner for the product-scope decision.
